functions.name: all_of
functions.done: Returns the 1-based position of each name in order, and errors if any name is missing.

check.case: all_of of v10000 through v1 on names v1 through v10000

proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyselect))
stopifnot(as.character(packageVersion("tidyselect")) == "1.2.1")

vars <- paste0("v", seq_len(10000))
wanted <- paste0("v", seq(10000, 1))
poke_vars(vars)
one <- function() {
  all_of(wanted)
}
value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}

iris <- c("Sepal.Length", "Sepal.Width", "Petal.Length", "Petal.Width", "Species")
example <- with_vars(iris, all_of(c("Sepal.Length", "Sepal.Width")))
out <- "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/tidyselect/docs/output/all_of-r.txt"
dir.create(dirname(out), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines(
  paste0(
    "with_vars(c(\"Sepal.Length\", \"Sepal.Width\", \"Petal.Length\", \"Petal.Width\", \"Species\"), all_of(c(\"Sepal.Length\", \"Sepal.Width\"))) returns ",
    paste(example, collapse = ", "),
    "."
  ),
  out
)

cat("VERSION ", as.character(packageVersion("tidyselect")), "\n", sep = "")
cat("VALUE ", paste(value, collapse = ","), "\n", sep = "")
cat(sprintf("MS %.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))
proof.python:
import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from tidyselect.helpers_vector import all_of

vars = [f"v{i}" for i in range(1, 10001)]
wanted = [f"v{i}" for i in range(10000, 0, -1)]


def one():
    return all_of(wanted, vars)


value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)

iris = ["Sepal.Length", "Sepal.Width", "Petal.Length", "Petal.Width", "Species"]
example = all_of(["Sepal.Length", "Sepal.Width"], iris)
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "docs" / "output" / "all_of-python.txt"
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(
    'with_vars(c("Sepal.Length", "Sepal.Width", "Petal.Length", "Petal.Width", "Species"), all_of(c("Sepal.Length", "Sepal.Width"))) returns '
    + ", ".join(str(item) for item in example)
    + ".\n",
    encoding="utf-8",
)

print("VALUE " + ",".join(str(item) for item in value))
print(f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}")
